reviews_used.author: Jennifer Bowers
reviews_used.text: Amazing and honest work he did my tv mount and it looks great very professional and quick solid work highly recommend for all your needs

reviews_used.author: Misael Porro
reviews_used.text: Had RS home services repair my wall and install a new towel rod! The service was wonderful, Raeed was super easy to work with and was very attentive to the work he was doing

reviews_used.author: Chris Chen
reviews_used.text: Amazing service from Raeed! Very fair pricing and was super helpful on the repairs I needed. Highly recommend to anyone looking

reviews_used.author: Pop N' Snax
reviews_used.text: A++ would recommend raeed and RS home services if you need anything repaired at your home they did a fantastic job fixing a few things in my house. Very punctual, careful and not over priced!

reviews_used.author: Josue Lopez-Garcia
reviews_used.text: Highly recommend did amazing work. Will be using in the near future. Great work with great price. Very professional. A+ score

notes: Variante adaptada (sin booking/precios fijos): CTA a telefono, servicios sin precio publicado ('se cotiza, escribenos'), sin mapa de reservas de citas. Formato elegido por tratarse de un handyman independiente sin sistema de citas online.
